claim.quote: We report the first evidence of charmless semileptonic decays of B mesons.

name: Observation of B-meson semileptonic decays to noncharmed final states
notes: result_type is evidence because the abstract says "first evidence"; the paper title says "Observation". CLASSE dates the b → u discovery to 1989 (submission year).

summary.plain: CLEO reported the first evidence that B mesons can decay semileptonically with no charm quark in the final state. The paper's title says observation; the abstract says first evidence.
summary.technical: CLEO (CLEO-2, Υ(4S)): first evidence of charmless semileptonic B decays b → u e ν and b → u μ ν in the lepton momentum interval 2.4-2.6 GeV/c, where the b → c background is negligible (Phys. Rev. Lett. 64, 16, 1990).

title: Observation of B-meson semileptonic decays to noncharmed final states
why_it_matters: CLEO's own timeline lists the 1989 discovery of b → u transitions among its major results.
